# GitHub Risers（GitHub 飙升榜）

> Open-source projects ranked by how fast they gain stars, grouped by category (AI first). Real numbers from the GitHub API every day at Beijing and Los Angeles midnight. MIT license.

## Docs
- [README](https://github.com/jammyfu/github-risers#readme): English rankings
- [README.zh-Hans.md](https://github.com/jammyfu/github-risers/blob/main/README.zh-Hans.md): 简体中文榜单
- [docs/CATEGORIES.md](https://github.com/jammyfu/github-risers/blob/main/docs/CATEGORIES.md): category rules (topics / keywords)
- [docs/NEW_ARRIVALS.md](https://github.com/jammyfu/github-risers/blob/main/docs/NEW_ARRIVALS.md): 7-day newcomers criteria
- [docs/DAILY_UPDATE.md](https://github.com/jammyfu/github-risers/blob/main/docs/DAILY_UPDATE.md): daily automation
- [data/projects.json](https://github.com/jammyfu/github-risers/blob/main/data/projects.json): tracked projects
- [data/stats.json](https://github.com/jammyfu/github-risers/blob/main/data/stats.json): latest growth stats
